conclusion: The actual refreshed Mobile SG request calls the public wrapper in admin context and generates the pinned local route. A bypass of the wrapper or non-admin routing context does not explain this phone attempt.
not_yet_proven: Phone-side SDK initialization, token acquisition, dial or actual Bridge handshake failure remains unresolved; absent transaction rows alone do not prove no token acquisition was attempted.

static_auth_trace.jwt_contract: VoiceRestUtilsSNC validates per-service voice_service_id via sn_auth.VoiceServiceInfoRequestor for three-part JWTs.
static_auth_trace.opaque_oauth_contract: VoiceRestUtilsSNC returns true for opaque OAuth with an explicit bypass warning; current bridge intentionally rejects that token form and this investigation has not relaxed the safeguard.
static_auth_trace.mobile_source_supported: isWebRTCSource recognizes MOBILE_WEBRTC, PLATFORM_WEBRTC and PLATFORM_TEXTCHAT.
